d: Long, flowing cinnamon-brown hair is styled with thick bangs and a single long strand trailing downward, paired with wide, cheerful olive-green eyes. The face is that of a young adolescent with a petite, slender build. The outfit consists of a white long-sleeved shirt under a maroon sleeveless pinafore dress, accented by a large teal bow at the neck and red shoulder straps. Signature details include large, grey mechanical ship components attached to the back and hips.
